description.subject: A small amigurumi doll made of cream and red yarn, with a round white face, standing among pebbles.
description.covering: A red hooded coat with white scalloped trim at the hem, cuffs, hood edge and front opening, fastened with two yellow discs, over turquoise leggings and brown boot-shaped foot covers, with sleeves reaching the wrists.
description.posture: It stands upright on both feet with its arms held slightly out from its sides, turned toward the camera.
description.setting: A plain pale grey studio surface and backdrop, with smooth river pebbles in tan, cream, brown and olive scattered across the foreground.
description.light: Soft, diffuse, even light from the front and slightly above, neutral white in colour, casting faint gentle shadows beneath the feet.
description.anomaly: Round pink felt patches on the cheeks and curled embroidered lashes above each glossy round bead pupil, set in an otherwise plain white yarn face.
